purpose: Teach: タップ/ブロードウェイ/弱み/できあがり/打ち明け/年末年始/放り/おしえ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、レジでタップしてお支払いしたわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's already tapped and paid at the register.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, reassuring. Clear delivery with no hesitation. Warm acknowledgment of a task completed. Slight upward inflection like she's checking he heard the good news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ブロードウェイってどこにあるの?
lines.style: Sudden curiosity, genuine question without self-consciousness. Quick delivery. The kind of left-field thing kids ask because they just heard the word and want to know. No filter, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、誰にでも弱みはあるのよ
lines.en: Sho, everyone has things they struggle with.
lines.style: Gentle, measured delivery. Like she's choosing each word carefully because it matters. Warm undertone but serious — not casual advice. Slight pause before the sentence like she's making sure she says this right.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとケーキのできあがりが嬉しい
lines.en: Mom, I'm so happy about making the cake with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, open delivery. Simple joy without overthinking it. Quick pace, warm tone. The kind of small happiness a six-year-old announces because it matters and he trusts you'll understand.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママに本音を打ち明けていいのよ
lines.en: Sho, you can tell Mom how you really feel.
lines.style: Soft but direct. Invitation rather than demand. Like she's creating safe space by being the one to say it first. Warm, patient pace. Slight trailing-off at the end — giving him room to speak.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、年末年始、お祖父ちゃんちに行くんだよね
lines.en: Mom, we're going to Grandpa's for New Year's, right?
lines.style: Forward-looking excitement. Question-inflection on the 「right?」part — he already knows the answer but wants confirmation from her. Warm, conversational pace. The comfort of anticipated ritual.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、靴下、お部屋に放りっぱなしダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't just leave your socks lying around the room.
lines.style: Light, practical correction. Not harsh — the tone of gentle household boundary-setting. Matter-of-fact with an undertone of affection. Like she's said it before and will say it again without frustration.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんに将棋おしえてもらう
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa's going to teach me shogi.
lines.style: Eager anticipation with certainty. Quick delivery, bright tone. The confidence of something he's looking forward to — like he's already imagining it. Small and genuine, no dramatizing.
